arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: both followed the stated goals. The proximal recovery lining's name suggested its role, though the result did not explain how recovery works.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it developed the body's response to drinking, but these two forced choices alone did not provide much gameplay or mechanistic detail.
